name_reason: Compliant: prefix data_fd2_battle_ (battle core table) + descriptor item_effect_table reflects both purpose (item stat/effect master table) and data type (table/array). No Ghidra address residue; 'item' is the domain noun, not an ID suffix. Matches the C struct type item_effect and the Ghidra struct item_entry it is typed as.
purpose: Read-only item stat/effect master table: one fixed 23-byte entry per item id 0..0xD6 (215 items), supplying type/AP/HT/DP/EV, special-effect (type+chance), attack range (min/max), use-effect dispatch code + params, cast-range/target/area flags, and shop price for the combat / AI / inventory / shop subsystems.
logic_summary: 215-entry array of struct item_effect (23-byte/0x17 stride, pack(1), little-endian; 4945 bytes @ 0x602AC..0x6160C). Reached exclusively through accessor fd2_get_item_effect_entry @ 0x4E56C, whose body computes EAX = item_id*0x17 and returns 0x602AD + EAX = &table[item_id].bTY (the returned pointer P aims at struct field +1, the type byte). Therefore a P-relative read at P+k targets struct offset (k+1): consumers read P[+0x0D]=use_effect, P[+0x10]=cast_range_flags, P[+0x11]=target_side, P[+0x12]=area as single bytes, and ap/ht/dp/ev/price as u16 words. 22 indirect callers across combat, AI, inventory and shop paths; 0 direct xrefs to 0x602AC (all access is arithmetic via the accessor). No game-side writer exists.
datatype: const item_effect[215]  (struct item_effect, 23-byte stride; Ghidra type item_entry[215], DT_LEN=4945)
element_semantics: Each element = one item_effect entry (18 fields / 23 bytes): +0 unknown_00 (prefix byte; 0x0B signature on entry 0, else 0x00); +1 type (item category: 01=sword 02=blade 03=spear 04=axe 05=bow 06=staff 07=claw 08=mech-arm 0x20=consumable...); +2 ap (u16 attack bonus); +4 ht (u16 hit-rate bonus); +6 dp (u16 defense bonus); +8 ev (u16 evasion bonus); +0x0A special_type (02=poison 03=double 04=crit); +0x0B special_chance (%); +0x0C range_min; +0x0D range_max; +0x0E use_effect (effect-code byte for use-effect dispatch); +0x0F use_param_lo, +0x10 use_param_hi (together a u16 effect param); +0x11 cast_range_flags (range class: <0x10 short / >=0x10 projectile; bit4=line, low4=distance); +0x12 target_side (0=enemy 1=self); +0x13 area (AoE shape/radius, max 3); +0x14 price (u16 gold); +0x16 trailing_22 (mostly 0x05).
notes: Name kept (already compliant). Src comment block (btltab3.c lines 122-144) verified accurate against the Ghidra item_entry struct (offsets/sizes identical), the C item_effect struct in src/include/types.h, the accessor fd2_get_item_effect_entry @ 0x4E56C, and consumers fd2_apply_use_effect_dispatch @ 0x20C6F / fd2_execute_ai_item_use @ 0x15055; all P-relative offset claims (P+0x0D/0x10/0x11/0x12 -> struct +0x0E/+0x11/+0x12/+0x13) and the 22-caller / no-writer / 4945-byte / id 0..0xD6 facts confirmed -> comment kept (no edit to btltab3.c).
